extractActionMetadata:2f5959eb58d3e57cf6:
{
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "a1",
      "action": "Whisk dry ingredients",
      "description": "In a large bowl, whisk the flour, baking soda, cornstarch, and salt together. Set aside.",
      "equipment": ["large bowl", "whisk"],
      "ingredients": ["all-purpose flour", "baking soda", "cornstarch", "salt"],
      "dependsOn": []
    },
    {
      "id": "a2",
      "action": "Whisk butter and sugars",
      "description": "In a medium bowl, whisk the melted butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar together until no lumps remain.",
      "equipment": ["medium bowl", "whisk"],
      "ingredients": ["unsalted butter", "light or dark brown sugar", "granulated sugar"],
      "dependsOn": []
    },
    {
      "id": "a3",
      "action": "Add egg and vanilla",
      "description": "Whisk in the egg and egg yolk until combined, then whisk in the vanilla extract.",
      "equipment": ["medium bowl", "whisk"],
      "ingredients": ["large egg + 1 egg yolk", "pure vanilla extract"],
      "dependsOn": ["a2"]
    },
    {
      "id": "a4",
      "action": "Combine wet and dry ingredients",
      "description": "Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and mix together with a large spoon or spatula until a soft, thick, and shiny dough forms.",
      "equipment": ["large bowl", "large spoon", "spatula"],
      "ingredients": [],
      "dependsOn": ["a1", "a3"]
    },
    {
      "id": "a5",
      "action": "Fold in chocolate chips",
      "description": "Fold in the chocolate chips, doing your best to combine them even if they do not stick easily due to the melted butter.",
      "equipment": ["spatula"],
      "ingredients": ["semi-sweet chocolate chips or chocolate chunks"],
      "dependsOn": ["a4"]
    },
    {
      "id": "a6",
      "action": "Chill the dough",
      "description": "Cover the dough tightly and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 3 days (overnight recommended).",
      "equipment": ["large bowl"],
      "ingredients": [],
      "dependsOn": ["a5"]
    },
    {
      "id": "a7",
      "action": "Prepare oven and baking sheets",
      "description": "Preheat oven to 325°F (163°C). Line large baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats.",
      "equipment": ["oven", "large baking sheets", "parchment paper", "silicone baking mats"],
      "ingredients": [],
      "dependsOn": []
    },
    {
      "id": "a8",
      "action": "Temper the dough",
      "description": "If the dough has chilled for longer than 2 hours, let it sit at room temperature for about 15 minutes before shaping.",
      "equipment": [],
      "ingredients": [],
      "dependsOn": ["a6", "a7"]
    },
    {
      "id": "a9",
      "action": "Shape the dough",
      "description": "Scoop dough (3 Tablespoons for XL, 2 Tablespoons for medium). Roll into a ball and shape with fingers to be taller than wide, like a cylinder.",
      "equipment": ["cookie scoop", "Tablespoon measuring spoon"],
      "ingredients": [],
      "dependsOn": ["a8"]
    },
    {
      "id": "a10",
      "action": "Bake the cookies",
      "description": "Arrange cookies 3 inches apart on sheets. Bake for 13–14 minutes until edges are lightly browned.",
      "equipment": ["oven", "large baking sheets"],
      "ingredients": [],
      "dependsOn": ["a9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "a11",
      "action": "Cool the cookies",
      "description": "Cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack to cool completely.",
      "equipment": ["large baking sheets", "cooling rack"],
      "ingredients": [],
      "dependsOn": ["a10"]
    },
    {
      "id": "a12",
      "action": "Add extra chips (optional)",
      "description": "While cookies are still warm, press a few more chocolate chips into the tops for appearance.",
      "equipment": [],
      "ingredients": ["semi-sweet chocolate chips or chocolate chunks"],
      "dependsOn": ["a11"]
    }
  ],
  "warnings": [
    "The cookie dough requires chilling prior to shaping to prevent overspreading.",
    "Chocolate chips may not stick to the dough easily because of the melted butter.",
    "Do not overbake; centers will look very soft but will set while cooling."
  ]
}
